A perfect stop on the way to Adiyogi from Bangalore! Kings Family Restaurant is conveniently located on the left side of the highway, about 15 km before Adiyogi, making it an excellent place to take a break during the drive. We visited on July2026 and loved the Restaurant.

The food was fresh, tasty, and reasonably priced. We especially enjoyed the North Indian dishes, and the service was quick and courteous. The restaurant has clean seating, ample parking, and a family-friendly atmosphere. The washrooms were also maintained well, which is a big plus for highway travelers. Staff are fantastic.

If you're planning a trip to Adiyogi or Nandi Hills, I highly recommend stopping here for breakfast, lunch, or a refreshing tea break. Great food, good service, and a convenient location make it worth visiting!

We had been here the last Sunday with friends. This place is truly amazing. Starting with plenty of parking space outside this hotel to the cool save calm ambience inside. Its more a hut based kind of setup, basically like a quadrilateral lawn with several bus along the periphery.
Most important, the service and the quality of food was very good. This guy called Sai Kumar or Prasad not sure, from Odisha was really a very active and customer friendly guy. He deserved us the drinks and the food items pretty fast.
The prices were also very nominal. I would say it is a must visit place to spend of you are travelling towards Chikkaballapur, Bellary or further ahead.
Thanks,

I went to to this place seeing so many stars on Google review for this place. But I have to say I was disappointed.

reviews.text: The food was absolutely wonderful.  If you're from HYDERABAD than definitely visit this place for some good taste tingling experience.

The Mystery Highway Huts turned out to be a real disappointment. The real mystery here is the food.
We were asked to try the Hyderabad Dum Biryani, claiming it was good—but it was not dum biryani at all. It was served without any gravy or raita.
Next, we ordered Guntur Chicken, and the taste was so bad that we couldn’t eat more than the first piece.
After that disappointment, we ordered Jeera Rice, and again it was served plain—no gravy, no raita. Raita was provided only after we specifically asked for it.
Overall, the food quality, taste, and service were not worth. I do not recommend this restaurant.

I strongly recommend everyone to avoid this restaurant. I had a terrible experience — the service was poor, two dishes were not served, the rice was undercooked, and they used tasting salt. Even street food tastes better than what I was served here. This was one of the worst dining experiences I’ve ever had.

Stopped by Mystery Highway Huts and had a good food experience. The dishes were tasty, well-cooked, and served fresh. The flavours were satisfying and the portion sizes were decent. The overall setup is simple and comfortable for a highway stop. While there’s still a little room for improvement, the food quality made the visit worthwhile.
